tables.how: Every organization record in the national registry file of November 2026 whose practice address is one San José address (58 give Apt A2, 4 give no apartment number): 62 numbers, issued 8 in May 2026, 7 in June 2026, 24 in July 2026, 17 in September 2026, 3 in October 2026, 3 in November 2026. 46 are registered as medical equipment and supplies, 16 are registered as clinical laboratory. The authorized official is the person each record names as able to act for the organization; the registry prints a contact telephone for that person, which is not reproduced here, only how many other numbers in these lists give the same one. Across the 83 provider numbers at the four addresses there are 21 different spellings of an official's name and 14 telephone numbers. Each number was looked up in three enrollment files on disk: Medicare's public enrollment file for California dated 1 October 2026, the State's Medi-Cal fee-for-service provider listing for the Bay Area dated 9 November 2026, and the federal Medicaid enrollment segments.
tables.limits: A provider number is free, is issued without inspection and is not a claim: none of these numbers is in an enrollment file on disk, and the public payment files end in 2024, before any of them existed. Numbers issued after a file's date could not be in it. A billing or company-formation service may register clients at its own address, and may pick the wrong category by mistake; a new business may register from a home before leasing premises. The registry does not check identity: a name on a record is what the filer typed, the same name on two records is not confirmed to be one person, and nobody listed is shown to be the same person as anyone of that name elsewhere. No authority has made a finding about any company or person listed.
